metadata.title: Synthetic shipping arrival analysis
metadata.arrival_definition: Arrival at assigned destination berth (berthing), for both scheduled and actual arrival.
metadata.weather_definition: Simplified forecast severity over the remaining route for the next 48 hours, known at prediction_time; not observed future weather.
metadata.schedule_definition: Schedule frozen as known at prediction_time. No later revisions are included.
metadata.coverage_note: Two calendar years of prediction snapshots. A few outcomes extend into January 2026. Empty or malformed actual_arrival means unknown outcome.
metadata.notice: Entirely synthetic, not SeaVantage data or model outputs. Port names are real labels; routes, distances, companies, weather, congestion and disruptions are fictional teaching approximations. Not navigation or operational data.
metadata.generation_note: Contains uneven seasonal weather, recurring routes, fictional congestion episodes, forecast mistakes, unexplained delays, early arrivals and intentional ETL defects. No built-in predicted-arrival column: you will create predictions.
